codegraph._env: CODEGRAPH_MCP_TOOLS re-enables the seven tools the MCP server hides by default (it lists only `explore`). NOTE: `codegraph install` REWRITES this file and drops the env block — verified 2026-08-26, when it silently reduced the surface back to one tool. Re-add it after any `codegraph install`, then re-run `node scripts/mcp-enable.mjs --verify`.
